classification.difficultyReason: Construct annual total waste from population and daily waste, apply the supplied time and mass conversions, then express the result in scientific notation.

content.prompt: At the beginning of 2011, the population of Australia was estimated to be approximately 22.5 million. If the population stayed the same for the next year, and each person in Australia produced an average of 0.712 kg of waste each day, how many tonnes of waste would be produced by Australians in the following year? (1 tonne = 1000 kg, 1 year = 365 days.) Express your answer in scientific notation.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Annual waste}&=(2.25\times10^7)\times0.712\times365\text{ kg}\\\text{Annual waste}&=5.8473\times10^9\text{ kg}\\\text{Annual waste}&=\frac{5.8473\times10^9}{10^3}\text{ tonnes}\\\text{Annual waste}&=5.8473\times10^6\text{ tonnes}\end{align*}$$
